review.method: Semantic curation, ink-aligned raster nearest-neighbor comparisons, side-by-side light and bold review, followed by six-style 16/20/24 pixel checks. Similarity scores are review aids; no published icon is removed.

reviewedDensity.orthogonal-view: Intentional four-by-four technical grid, reviewed at 16/20/24 pixels on both backgrounds, including stroke 2. Detail strokes are 1.1; bold cells have transparent 1.3-unit gaps.
